principle: DEVELOPMENT (build/research/improve the platform) is strictly SEPARATE from PRODUCT (the runtime that serves customers). Dev tools/loops/data are owner/CI/agent-launched, NEVER shipped or served to customers, and store under data/dev-intel/ + docs/. Product modules/actions are the runtime; they NEVER import dev tools and store to the governed product streams (storage_tier_policy). DEV may read product infra; PRODUCT must not depend on DEV. Enforced by scripts/check_plane_separation.py.

development.purpose: research + review + improve our own codebase/product (NOT customer-facing)
development.access: owner / CI / agents during development ONLY. Never returned to a customer, never used in product serving.

product.purpose: the runtime that serves customers — Baltor context engine + Teleon control plane
actions: capability tasks (document->schema extraction, search+LLM enrichment, OFAC sanctions screening, ...)
the descent runtime (improve a capability over time)
data_paths: storage_tier_policy product streams: cdc_events, version_history, component_candidates, object_embeddings
product.access: tenant-scoped + governed (serves_truth law, receipts, promotion boundary); customer-facing.

shared_infra.purpose: low-level infra BOTH planes use (so product never imports a dev tool, and dev never owns product runtime)
shared_infra.note: scripts/_llm_client.py = the OpenAI-compatible LLM client (PRODUCT real_steps + DEV tools both call it); scripts/_jsonl_store.py = the SQLite-WAL append-log behind the JSONL contract. PRODUCT may import shared_infra; it must NOT import a DEVELOPMENT tool.

rules: PRODUCT modules (src/teleon, src/baltor) MUST NOT import DEVELOPMENT tools (they MAY import shared_infra).
DEVELOPMENT tools live under scripts/ (not src/), may READ product infra, and MUST NOT write to product data paths.
DEVELOPMENT data lives under data/dev-intel/ (+ docs/reviews, docs/context); PRODUCT data lives in the storage_tier_policy product streams.
Every storage_tier_policy stream declares plane: development | product.
Model output + research findings are CANDIDATES (serves_truth=false) on BOTH planes; a DEV candidate never reaches product serving.
